summary.zh: 容量不是能否装下，而是还能否带着它行动。
summary.en: Capacity governs movement as well as storage.

rules.zh: 每件物品贡献重量，累计超额后行动受到限制。玩家比较用途与重量，丢弃、存放或分批搬运战利品；重量条将看不见的后勤成本变成即时反馈。
rules.en: Every carried item adds weight; exceeding capacity restricts movement. Compare usefulness to weight, then discard, cache or haul goods in separate trips, guided by the load meter.

decisions.zh: 低价值重物值得多走一趟，还是应留给后续专门运输？
decisions.en: Does bulky low-value loot justify another trip or a dedicated haul later?

decisions.zh: 把容量用于收益还是安全补给？
decisions.en: Spend capacity on profit or on a safety margin?

effect.zh: 突然无法行动制造强制取舍；渐进减速让风险更可估量。
effect.en: A hard movement stop forces decisions; gradual slowdown makes risk easier to estimate.

effect.zh: 距离越远，路线与中转点越有价值。
effect.en: Longer unloading routes make caches and route planning more valuable.

cases.game: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
cases.gameZh: 上古卷轴5：天际 特别版

implementation.zh: 超过负重上限会限制跑动和快速旅行，物品价值与重量形成清晰的取舍。
implementation.en: Exceeding carry capacity restricts running and fast travel, creating a value-versus-weight trade-off.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：观察携带装备的角色与野外环境；本图没有负重条或超重状态提示。
observation.en: System reference: an equipped character in the wilderness; neither the weight meter nor encumbrance status is shown.

implementation.zh: 背包同时受格数与重量约束；超重会消耗移动所需耐力，迫使玩家减载。
implementation.en: The inventory has both slots and weight; encumbrance drains stamina when moving, forcing a lighter load.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：装备中的角色与探索环境。画面不显示负重、修理窗口或墓碑回收过程。
observation.en: System reference: an equipped character in an exploration setting; weight, repair menus and grave retrieval are not shown.

contrast.zh: 《天际》主要限制移动方式；《英灵神殿》又把负重接入耐力预算，并保留格数限制。
contrast.en: Skyrim primarily restricts movement modes; Valheim also ties load to stamina and retains a separate slot limit.

combination.zh: 组合提案：救援游戏允许拖拽伤员，但伤员重量会挤占撤离途中可带的补给。
combination.en: Design proposal: rescuing an injured traveler consumes the same hauling budget as evacuation supplies.

setup.zh: 负重上限是 20，你已带 18，新矿石重 5。
setup.en: Your carrying limit is 20; you carry 18 and find ore weighing 5.

action.zh: 你放下重 4 的普通石头，带上矿石。
action.en: Drop 4 weight of common stone and take the ore.

result.zh: 总重回到限制内，可以正常返程，但放弃了一部分材料。
result.en: Your load is within the limit, allowing normal travel at the cost of some materials.

next.zh: 回基地卸货，再决定是否专门回来搬剩余物资。
next.en: Unload at base, then decide whether the remaining supplies justify another trip.

firstStep.zh: 做十种有重量与用途的物品、一条负重条和超重减速。
firstStep.en: Create ten weighted items with distinct uses, a load meter, and an overload slowdown.

pitfall.zh: 物品价值如果总和重量成正比，取舍会退化成固定排序。
pitfall.en: If value always scales directly with weight, decisions collapse into a fixed ranking.

test.zh: 改变下一次任务需求，观察玩家是否保留不同物品而非总按售价排序。
test.en: Change the next mission’s needs and see whether kept items change beyond resale value.
